name: OpenAI Stargate Wisconsin

timeline.event: Ground broken for the facility, land clearing begins for all buildings
Land clearing continues, foundation construction clearly begins for eastern and northern buildings (Building 1-2)
Construction continues, Buildings 1 and 2 appear roughly halfway roofed, and building 3 foundation is halfway done.

Building 4 and supporting facilities/buildings operational, whole facility now operational. Based on the [environmental analysis (page 6)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ft2ZzqAYZtsTqMwyML4eo_EFYuclVxE6/view?usp=sharing) filed for the sit

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)

explain: OpenAI Stargate Wisconsin is an under-construction AI data center in Port Washington, WI, owned by oracle and used by openai. Epoch AI estimates it draws 0 MW today and 1,300 MW when finished.
